# Galen Marten Music

> Official website of Galen Marten — a one-man band from Ohio. Galen performs
> guitar, harmonica, foot percussion, and vocals simultaneously, playing
> covers from every major genre plus original Americana / folk-rock songs.
> He plays 500+ shows' worth of experience at patios, pubs, breweries, and
> docksides around Lake Erie (Sandusky, Port Clinton, Huron, Put-in-Bay) and
> is available to book for venues, festivals, and private events.

Key facts:
- One-man band: guitar + harmonica + foot drums + vocals, live and solo
- 30+ years of experience, 500+ shows performed
- Based in Ohio; plays primarily around the Lake Erie shore
- Latest single: "Live Free" (feat. Rachel Sekerak), written for the
  documentary "Am I Happy?" from Freedomology Films
- First live album releases November 28 with a release show at Coda in
  Tremont (Cleveland)
- Booking contact: gsmarten@gmail.com or the contact form

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.galenmartenmusic.com/): overview, next shows, new single, merch highlights
- [Upcoming shows](https://www.galenmartenmusic.com/shows/): current show dates with venues, times, and directions (updated regularly)
- [Song list](https://www.galenmartenmusic.com/song-list/): full searchable repertoire — classic rock, country, modern rock, Americana, pub songs, and Galen's originals
- [About Galen](https://www.galenmartenmusic.com/about/): bio, photos, testimonials from venue hosts
- [News](https://www.galenmartenmusic.com/news/): latest announcements (live album, band openings)
- [Media](https://www.galenmartenmusic.com/media/): music videos, live performance videos, Spotify players for the albums "The Blue EP" (2012) and "Pictures on the Wall" (2003)
- [Merch](https://www.galenmartenmusic.com/merch/): official print-on-demand merch (tees, hats, beanies, hoodies) fulfilled by Printful
- [Contact / booking](https://www.galenmartenmusic.com/contact/): booking inquiry form for venues and private events
